commit_message:
[Merged] Fix various problems to do with segment promotion. Add test file fts4growth2.test, containing tests to check that the FTS index does not grow indefinitely as the table is updated.

FossilOrigin-Name: 21491a9bc686e63bec32f1a67103622f1160a2f9
pr_title: Improve FTS segment promotion and handle corrupt size records safely
pr_description:
Improve segment promotion so FTS indexes remain bounded as tables are updated. Parse end_block magnitudes with unsigned arithmetic and guard the minimum signed 64-bit value before applying the sign to the segment byte count.

Validation: source syntax check, seven extracted-parser boundary cases under UBSan, and workspace validation passed.

Fix various problems to do with segment promotion. Add test file fts4growth2.test, containing tests to check that the FTS index does not grow indefinitely as the table is updated.

FossilOrigin-Name: 21491a9bc686e63bec32f1a67103622f1160a2f9
fix_commit_message:
Fix a signed integer overflow that could occur in fts3 when processing corrupt database records. Bug [bugs:/info/2026-06-11T23:12:25Z | 2026-06-11T23:12:25Z].

FossilOrigin-Name: 978d04f051c06aff798f915b0774da19a0b4f89f9daee124f7e62b12afaaced8
agent_reasoning: The sign-handling logic could multiply INT64_MIN by -1 when processing a corrupt end_block record, causing signed integer overflow. The parser now forces the multiplier to 1 at that boundary, using a local constant expression because this snapshot lacks a shared FTS constant. Unsigned accumulation and explicit signed conversions match the supplied fix's parsing context and avoid overflow before the guard. Only ext/fts3/fts3_write.c was edited; test files and Fossil metadata were left unchanged.
